neighbours.label: take/taking/took where 'the time' or 'care' is expected next (thank you for taking ..., take the time to)
fire: Thanks so much for taking the time to fill out our survey.
We really appreciate you taking the time to answer our questions.
Please take a moment to review your order before paying.
I want to thank everyone for taking part in the charity run.
Our staff took great care of my mother during her stay.
Many thanks for taking the trouble to write such a detailed reply.
She always takes the time to listen to her students.
Thank you, Dr. Lane, for taking such good care of our dog.
